newsitem.title: USA: Tropical cyclone intensifies off Madagascar - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Tropical cyclone intensifies off Madagascar - WSC.

text.p: LEXINGTON, Mass., Feb 13 - Reuter) -Tropical Cyclone Josie has intensified over the last 12 hours and has again become a significant threat to shipping, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Thursday.
Top winds have reached 85 mph. Josie will continue fairly strong for another 12 hours before starting to weaken. It is expected to become extratropical later in the 48-72 hour period.
Its track will take it just to the southwest of Madagascar during this period.
